paper_metadata.title: High-temperature oxidation behavior of Ni-based superalloys with Nb and Y and the interface characteristics of oxidation scales

The four specimens all exhibit layered oxidation scales, i.e. an outer layer with loose TiO2 (no protective), an intermediate layer with dense Cr2O3 and NiCr2O4 (protective) and an inner layer of Al2O3.
TiO2 tends to be agminate on the surface in irregular shapes, and micro-cracks are observed on the rough surface, as Fig. 5b shows.
